crew.overview: After a global war, the seaside kingdom known as the Valley of the Wind remains one of the last strongholds on Earth untouched by a poisonous jungle and the powerful insects that guard it. Led by the courageous Princess Nausicaä, the people of the Valley engage in an epic struggle to restore the bond between humanity and Earth.
crew.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

details.biography:
Mitsuki Nakamura (中村 光毅, Nakamura Mitsuki, April 7, 1944 – May 16, 2011) was an animation art director, mechanical designer and illustrator from Tokyo.

He is the art director of works such as Mobile Suit Gundam and Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind. His representative works as a mechanical designer include Science Ninja Team Gatchaman and Mach GoGoGo. He died at his home in Tokyo on May 16, 2011 due to oral cancer; he was 67 years old.
details.name: Mitsuki Nakamura
